result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a section header shows an untranslated localization key instead of actual content.

issues.description: Section header below 'Fastest near you' displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the correct localized string (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add fallback handling for missing translations so keys never render to users.
